youtube.title: Why Some Pills Have a Line Across 💊 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Some tablets have a groove called a score line. It is pressed in during manufacturing so the tablet can be broken into more even halves when a doctor or pharmacist says it is safe to split. Not every pill is designed to be split, so follow the instructions on the pack.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
